final.memo:
the Company remains a wonderful business with an enviable consumer ecosystem and a management team that acts like owners [D01]. We continue to hold the company in high regard, and our core thesis regarding its durability and service-based growth is fully intact [D01], [D03]. However, the institutional imperative requires us to manage the size of our commitments when they reach such an outsized weight in our portfolio [D08]. 

At a P/E of 28.5x, the shares are fully priced, particularly when compared to the 4.50% yield available on U.S. government bonds [D04]. While we are not market timers and never sell a wonderful business simply because Mr. Market is enthusiastic, our approach to capital allocation dictates that we maintain a prudent weight across our holdings [D04], [D08]. 

We accept that trimming this position incurs a 21% federal tax cost, but we believe this is a sensible trade-off given the sheer scale of the holding and the desire to maintain liquidity in a fully priced market [D04], [D08]. We are not abandoning the thesis; we are merely rightsizing an investment that has performed exceptionally well over many years [D07].
